title: Trim and Lift off on a block main clip write only the group row
test: simple P2.1 · review A and D on a main block (a clip grouped in Full with a group look) refuse with Open in Full and move nothing (DESIGN §9.1 main blocks)
note: Fixed the 2.1 half (A/D reach planTrimTail/planTrimHead via editor-mode onKey). Both trims now refuse when the main unit's layer is a group, using a new trimBlock line plus an Open in Full button. Commit ceeb2dd2. Before the fix: group 4+2, member still 4+4, C moved to 6. Lift off is 2.2 (planLift is not on this branch). New words key 'Open in Full to trim this': DESIGN says only 'the block line' and gives the split wording, so this wording is a call Ezra may want to see.

title: Delete's middle cut of a whole-video muted video drops its tail flag
test: simple P2.1 · review Delete that cuts a muted whole-video overlay keeps the end-with-the-video flag on its later piece, so the next trim still takes it to the end (§4.3)
note: plan.resized.add(B.id) in planDelete's (iii) media pre step. Commit 6de83ef1. Before the fix: B.sm = {stay, tailEnd:12, cut}, with tail gone. The refuter's 'delete C, L2 ends at 4' step cannot work (L2 starts at 4), so the test checks the next trim instead: D on C to 6 must take the piece to 6.

title: Trims check the blend on one side only
test: simple P2.1 · review a trim never shortens a clip under twice the crossfade on its OTHER side, so a blend never turns into a red overlap (§3.1)
note: planTrimTail now also refuses fadesBefore (p|c blend). planTrimHead now also refuses fadesNext (c|n blend). Each half was seen failing on its own before its fix (seam became 'overlap 1'). The 2x-fade controls still pass. Commit f91e1cf0.

title: A clip added or duplicated in Simple can come back blank ({noSave})
test: simple P2.1 · review a clip duplicated in Simple has its footage on disk at once: locking the phone straight after cannot bring the copy back blank (queue 681)
note: Fixed the duplicate half. planDuplicate sets plan.mints, and S.edit calls FM.storage.save() straight after its one commit. Commit 0a14027d. Before the fix, readMedia(copy) was null after flushSync. Control: Full's duplicate passes the same check. For 2.2: the addRecs routes (Append, Insert, Overlay, Music) must also set plan.mints = true.

title: Add clips / Insert / Overlay / Music can ripple after a switch to Full
note: The race is the readPicked await, which is 2.2. Seen in passing and not fixed: S.drain re-arms with setTimeout while jobDepth()>0 (and returns without re-arming while history is muted), so queued edits wait with S.running false. Adding queue.length to busyReason could hold the switch shut forever if the queue is stranded, so that belongs with the 2.2 afterRead/busyReason fix.

title: Tail's new end computed as trackEnd + d, end card misses by 1 ulp
test: simple P2.1 · review an end card lands bit-exact on the new end of the clips after every command, so no 1-ulp black frame opens before it (§3.1)
note: ripple() now returns end, the last clip's end exactly as apply() writes it. Delete, both trims, close gap and duplicate land the tail on it (or on start + new duration when the edited clip is last). Commit aff3faea. Before the fix: D and A cases off by 1 ulp, plus a seeded sweep that missed in tail 9/60, head 16/60, close gap 9/29, delete 10/60. After: zero.

title: Deleting a clip that owns a fade-in cuts long items by b−a
test: simple P2.1 · review deleting a clip that fades in over the one before cuts what runs on through the time that really went, so a voice-over stays in step (§3.6 Delete row)
note: Used the refuter's corrected fix: the cut starts at ca = p.end when c's fade went with it (len = −dt). Case (i) lands at ca, (ii) trims to ca, (iii) splits at ca. Commit 6d014a35. Before the fix the voice ran 1 s ahead: [[2,2,0],[4,4,8]] vs [[2,3,0],[5,4,8]]. The title end in the test was moved off the track end, because the tail fit would otherwise repair it and hide the bug.

note: The cutKeys refusal now also counts FM.isAnimated(l.speed). S.keyCount is unchanged for the tail fit. Commit 98bfcfb9. Before the fix, case (i) drifted 0.4-1.4 s of source and case (iii) also drifted. A flat-speed song is the control and is still cut in step.
